introduction: Figures come from COA Annual Audit Reports and appear only after sign-off.

topics.title: Financial Condition
topics.summary: What the government owned and owed on December 31. Loaded for Tuguegarao City only.

metrics.label: Assets
metrics.meaning: Everything the government owns, such as cash, receivables, land, buildings and roads.

metrics.label: Liabilities
metrics.meaning: Everything the government owes, such as payables, loans and funds held for others.

metrics.label: Government Equity
metrics.meaning: Assets minus Liabilities. It is not ownership; no one holds shares.

topics.title: Results of Operation
topics.summary: Income the government earned and the costs it recognized in the year, including non-cash ones.

metrics.label: Income
metrics.meaning: Government income for the fiscal year, including its share of national taxes. Not business income.

metrics.label: Expenses
metrics.meaning: Government expenses, including depreciation and transfers. Not cash paid.

metrics.label: Net Income
metrics.meaning: Income less Expenses. A loss is shown in parentheses.

topics.title: Budget Execution
topics.summary: Appropriations are the budget the council passed. Allotments release it to offices. Obligations are commitments made, not cash paid.

metrics.label: Current Appropriations
metrics.meaning: This year's budget, passed by ordinance.

metrics.label: Current Allotments
metrics.meaning: The part of this year's budget released to offices. Tuguegarao City only.

metrics.label: Continuing Allotments
metrics.meaning: Unused budget from the year before that remains available. Tuguegarao City only.

metrics.label: Current Obligations
metrics.meaning: Commitments such as contracts and payroll charged to this year's budget.

metrics.label: Continuing Obligations
metrics.meaning: Commitments charged to continuing allotments. Tuguegarao City only.

topics.title: Revenue Sources
topics.summary: Revenue by source as printed in the Statement of Financial Performance. National transfers can move revenue without a change in local business activity.

metrics.label: Tax Revenue
metrics.meaning: Taxes collected by the local government, as reported.

metrics.label: Share from National Collections
metrics.meaning: The local government share of national tax collections, as reported.

metrics.label: Other Shares from National Taxes
metrics.meaning: Other shares from national taxes, such as national wealth, as reported.

metrics.label: Service and Business Income
metrics.meaning: Income from services, fees and government business. Not private-business sales.

metrics.label: Shares, Grants and Donations
metrics.meaning: Shares, grants and donations received, as reported.

metrics.label: Other Income
metrics.meaning: Gains and miscellaneous income, as reported.

topics.title: Business Taxes and Fees
topics.summary: General Fund collections tied to business, permits, markets and property. Never added to the consolidated totals.

metrics.label: Business Tax
metrics.meaning: The Business Tax line in the General Fund.

metrics.label: Permit Fees
metrics.meaning: Permit fee revenue in the General Fund.

metrics.label: Market Operations
metrics.meaning: Receipts from government market operations.

metrics.label: Real Property Tax
metrics.meaning: Basic real property tax, net of the reported discount.
metrics.formula: Basic Real Property Tax minus its discount.

topics.title: Budget and Actual Amounts
topics.summary: Actual amounts under the Development Fund and Economic Services headings.

metrics.label: 20% Development Fund
metrics.meaning: Actual amounts under the 20% Development Fund heading.
metrics.formula: Sum of reported actual amounts under the heading.

metrics.label: Economic Services
metrics.meaning: Actual amounts for offices such as agriculture, trade and tourism.
metrics.formula: Sum of reported actual amounts under the heading.

topics.title: Business Trends
topics.summary: Annual registered business activity for one industry or Business Category. Shown only with simulated records.

metrics.label: Active Businesses
metrics.meaning: Businesses recorded as new or renewed for the year.
metrics.formula: Count of new and renewed business-year records.

metrics.label: New Registrations
metrics.meaning: Businesses newly registered in the year.

metrics.label: Closed Businesses
metrics.meaning: Businesses formally closed in the year.

notes.title: Reading the Table
notes.text: The Executive Summary lists each line as COA prints it, one column per fiscal year; a year opens its Yearly Summary. The Yearly Summary shows that year, the year before and the change between them. A loss or a fall in pesos is shown in parentheses. The Source line opens the COA report at the cited page. Change compares consecutive comparable years and does not rate performance. A missing figure says why.

notes.title: Coverage
notes.text: Fiscal years 2019 to 2025. Executive Summary totals cover all 29 towns for 2020 to 2024 and 13 towns for 2025. Financial Condition, Allotments, Continuing Obligations and breakdowns beyond totals are loaded for Tuguegarao City only. Full-year 2026 waits for a released report.

notes.title: Sum of Reporting Towns
notes.text: The sum of the city and municipal governments that reported, not the provincial government. Coverage states how many of the 29 towns reported, and change uses only towns reporting both years.

notes.title: What These Figures Are
notes.text: Government accounts. They are not private-business sales, GDP or a measure of economic growth. Sign-off checks the transcription, not the audit.
